module_role: Project, sheet, scale, and review-scope ground truth for the supplied USDA ARS laboratory mechanical set. Project locality is not inferred because no city/state is established by the supplied sheets.
scope: Project, sheet, scale and full-page-review context for the supplied 19-page USDA ARS laboratory mechanical set. Locality is left unknown because the supplied sheets do not establish it.
